# Brigham and Women's Hospital

> > Brigham and Women's Hospital (BWH) is a leading academic medical center in Boston providing specialized clinical care, advanced research, and medical education across neurosciences, oncology, psychiatry, surgery, and women's health.

BWH is a Mass General Brigham teaching affiliate of Harvard Medical School, offering comprehensive medical services ranging from specialized cancer treatment at the Dana-Farber Brigham Cancer Center to advanced surgical programs and mental health services. The hospital operates multiple locations throughout the Boston area and provides both in-person and virtual care services.

## Key Topics

- Dana-Farber Brigham Cancer Center
- Neurosciences Center
- Surgical oncology
- Women's Health Center of Excellence
- Hepatology and liver disease
- Depression and mental health services
- Minimally invasive surgery
- Medical research and clinical trials
- Reconstructive and restorative surgery
- Musculoskeletal imaging
- Gastrointestinal disorders
- Virtual care and telehealth
- Pathology services
- Stroke center

## Cancer Care and Oncology

- [Treatment Options Cervical Cancer - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/cancer/cervical-cancer/treatment-options): Cervical cancer treatment options at Dana-Farber Brigham Cancer Center
- [Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/surgery/surgical-oncology/gastrointestional-stromal-tumor-sarcoma-gist): GIST sarcoma treatment through BWH surgical oncology
- [Diagnosis and Stages of Rectal Cancer - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/cancer/rectal-cancer/diagnosis-and-stages): Rectal cancer diagnosis & staging information at BWH oncology
- [BWH Surgical Oncology Care Team and Contact Information - Dana-Farber Brigham Cancer Center - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/cancer/pancreatic-cancer/pancreatic-cancer-team-and-contact): Pancreatic cancer surgical oncology team contact at Dana-Farber Brigham

## Neurosciences and Neurology

- [Neuroscience Center - Boston Neuroscience - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/neurosciences-center): Neurology, neurosurgery & psychiatry services at BWH Neurosciences Center
- [Neurologic Performing Arts Program - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/neurology/performing-arts-clinic): Specialized neurologic care for musicians with performance-related injuries
- [Stroke Center Earns AHA/ASA Award - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/neurosciences-center/stroke-honor-roll-elite-plus-quality-achievement-award): BWH Stroke Center receives AHA/ASA Elite Plus Gold Quality Achievement Award

## Psychiatry and Mental Health

- [Depression Center - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/psychiatry/brigham-psychiatric-specialties/depression-center): Depression treatment & outpatient services at BWH Depression Center
- [Eating Disorders - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/psychiatry/eating-disorders): Eating disorder treatment at BWH Psychiatry Department

## Surgery and Surgical Services

- [Department of Surgery Research - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/surgery/surgery-research): Surgery research administration & funding at BWH Department of Surgery
- [Advanced Minimally Invasive Surgery Fellowship - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/surgery/for-medical-professionals/advanced-minimally-invasive-surgical-fellowship): Advanced minimally invasive surgery fellowship training program at BWH
- [Westwood General Surgery Services – Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/westwood-health-care-center/westwood-services/general-surgery): Comprehensive surgical treatment at Mass General Brigham Westwood location
- [Center for Reconstructive and Restorative Surgery Research - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/research/labs-and-projects/reconstructive-and-restorative-surgery/center-for-reconstructive-and-restorative-surgery-research): Reconstructive & restorative surgery research center at BWH

## Gastroenterology and Hepatology

- [Liver (Hepatology) Program – Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/medicine/gastroenterology-hepatology-and-endoscopy/hepatology/hepatology-program): Liver disorder diagnosis & care at Brigham and Women's Hepatology Program

## Women's Health and Pathology

- [Women's Health Center of Excellence - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/womens-health-center-of-excellence): Gender-specific routine & complex care at BWH Women's Health Center
- [Women's and Perinatal Pathology - Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/pathology/womens-and-perinatal-pathology): Women's & perinatal pathology division at BWH Department of Pathology

## Imaging and Virtual Care

- [Musculoskeletal Imaging - BWH Radiology Department](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/radiology/musculoskeletal-imaging-and-intervention): Musculoskeletal imaging & intervention services in BWH Radiology Dept
- [Virtual Health Care Services – Brigham and Women's Hospital](https://www.brighamandwomens.org/virtual-care/virtual-visits): Telehealth, virtual visits & e-care services at Brigham and Women's
